full_text_zh:
[P1] 浑水摸鱼

[P2] 唐朝的时候，契丹人经常侵犯幽州，朝廷只好把鼎鼎有名的大将张守珪派到了幽州。张守珪一上任，果然将契丹人打得连连败退。

[P3] 这天大清早，契丹使者来到了幽州城门外，"砰砰砰"拍响了城门。他带给张守珪一封投降信。
投降？
契丹人真的会投降吗？

[P4] 张守珪才不相信呢，契丹人一定是来打探幽州军情的！但他还是接过了信，心想：‘契丹派人到幽州来，我们也可以派人到契丹去呀。如果想办法让契丹内部混乱起来，我们就能趁机剿灭他们了。’

[P5] 张守珪派王悔跟随信使，来到了契丹的营地。王悔向契丹首领递上了张守珪的信，说道："幽州长史张守珪大人，派我来和贵部商谈投降的事。"契丹首领接过信，却哈哈大笑说："这是大事，不用着急！晚上，我们先为大唐的使臣接风吧！"

[P6] 晚宴上，契丹首领不停地请王悔喝酒吃肉。王悔一边喝酒，一边观察。他发现，名叫过折的契丹大将沉着脸，闷头喝酒，一句话也没有说过。王悔猜想这位契丹大将和首领之间似乎有矛盾。

[P7] 一连几天，白天契丹首领带着王悔在草原上赏景打猎；天黑了以后，就烤肉喝酒，绝口不提投降的事。
王悔知道了，契丹人并不是真的想投降。他还观察到，契丹人的部落每隔几天就向西北迁移一次。
难道，他们想逃跑？

[P8] 王悔心中生了疑。
第二天，他就来到契丹大将过折的营帐中试探。
他故意满脸敬佩地说："将军，
我真没想到，你们的首领如此英
武豪爽，真是草原上的勇士呀！"

[P9] 可是，听了王悔的话，过折的鼻子都要气歪了。他捏紧拳头，大吼道：‘他才不是什么勇士呢，他是草原上最狡诈的狼！他有什么才干？这十年来，他四处打仗，我们部落伤亡了多少勇士！’

[P10] 王悔吃惊地瞪大了眼睛。
过折继续说道："你来了这么多天，首领说过投降的事吗？告诉你吧，他根本就不是真的要投降。"王悔听了这话，从怀中掏出一封信，交给过折说："我们张大人早就知道了，契丹首领只是诈降。他叮嘱我，让我来找将军合作呢！"

[P11] 封我为王？
过折一边疑惑地看着信，一边听王悔说："将军是个真英雄！论才能，您比您的首领可强多了。如果您与我们合作，张大人愿意在唐王面前保举，封您为王。"
"封我为王？"过折高兴得眼睛发亮。

[P12] "这些天，部落一直在向西北迁移，你知道是为什么吗？首领已经跟突厥人约好了地点，要联合起来杀掉唐朝使团，跟唐朝大战一场呢！"过折说，"要合作反击，就得在和突厥人会合前动手！"
"好，我马上回幽州城，向张大人报告，我们三天后动手。"王悔立刻答应道。

[P13] 当天晚上，王悔就带着使团，
悄悄逃出契丹部落，赶回了
幽州城。
天亮后，契丹首领发现王悔
逃跑了，气得哇哇大叫。

[P14] 到了约定的那天深夜，契丹部落里的篝火已经熄灭，除了巡逻的士兵，一个人影也看不见。过折带着一队人马，轻手轻脚地分头扑向契丹首领的营帐。
"快来人，抓刺客！"契丹首领惊叫起来。可是，还没等士兵们冲过来，他就被过折抓住了。

[P15] "冲啊！"突然，契丹部落外响起了喊杀声。原来，是张守珪带着人马来偷袭了。他和过折里应外合，顺利夺取了契丹部落的统领权。张守珪把这个好消息传报到长安，唐玄宗封过折做了北平王，统领契丹，边关终于平定了。

[P16] 在混浊的水中，鱼儿晕头转向，辨不清方向。这时候抓鱼就轻松了。张守珪和王悔正是利用契丹大将对首领的不满，成功挑起了契丹的内乱，将契丹这池静水搅浑，趁机平定了边境危机。这样的计策就叫“浑水摸鱼”。
full_text_en:
[P1] Muddying the Waters to Catch Fish

[P2] During the Tang Dynasty, the Khitans frequently invaded Youzhou. The imperial court had no choice but to send the renowned general Zhang Shougui to Youzhou. As soon as Zhang Shougui took office, he indeed defeated the Khitans repeatedly.

[P3] Early in the morning, a Khitan envoy arrived at the gates of Youzhou, banging on the gate with a 'bang bang bang'. He brought a letter of surrender to General Zhang Shugui.
Surrender?
Could the Khitans really be surrendering?

[P4] Zhang Shougui didn't believe it. The Khitans must have come to spy on Youzhou's military situation! But he still took the letter and thought: 'If the Khitans send people to Youzhou, we can also send people to the Khitans. If we can find a way to cause chaos within the Khitan ranks, we could then eliminate them while they're in disarray.'

[P5] Zhang Shugui sent Wang Hui to follow the messenger to the Khitan camp. Wang Hui handed the letter from Zhang Shugui to the Khitan leader and said, "General Zhang Shugui of Youzhou, sent me to discuss the matter of surrender with your forces." The Khitan leader took the letter, then laughed loudly and said, "This is a big matter; no need to rush! Tonight, let's first welcome the envoy of the Tang Dynasty!"

[P6] At the banquet, the Khitan chief kept inviting Wang Hui to drink wine and eat meat. Wang Hui drank while observing. He noticed that the Khitan general named Guo Zhe had a gloomy face, drank silently, and said not a word. Wang Hui guessed there might be some conflict between this general and the chief.

[P7] For several days, during the day, the Khitan leader took Wang Hui hunting and sightseeing on the grasslands; after dark, they grilled meat and drank wine, never mentioning surrender.
Wang Hui realized the Khitans were not truly willing to surrender. He also noticed that their tribe moved northwest every few days.
Could it be... they are planning to flee?

[P8] Wang Hui began to have doubts.
The next day, he went to the tent of the Khitan general Guo Zhe to probe.
He deliberately said with admiration: "General,
I never expected your leader to be so heroic and bold, truly a warrior of the grasslands!"

[P9] However, after hearing Wang Hui's words, Guo Zhe's nose almost twisted with anger. He clenched his fists and roared: 'He is not a brave warrior at all! He is the most cunning wolf on the grasslands! What talent does he have? For the past ten years, he has been fighting everywhere, and how many brave warriors has our tribe lost!'

[P10] Wang Hui stared in shock, his eyes wide.
Guo Zhe continued, "You've been here for so many days. Has the chief ever mentioned surrendering? Let me tell you, he's not really planning to surrender." Upon hearing this, Wang Hui took a letter from his chest and handed it to Guo Zhe, saying, "Our General Zhang has known all along that the Khitan chief is only pretending to surrender. He instructed me to come find you, General, to work together!"

[P11] Make me king?
While Guo Zhe looked at the letter with suspicion, he listened to Wang Hui say: "General, you are a true hero! In terms of ability, you are far superior to your leader. If you cooperate with us, General Zhang is willing to recommend you to the Tang Emperor and make you king."
"Make me king?" Guo Zhe's eyes lit up with joy.

[P12] "These days, the tribe has been moving northwest. Do you know why? The chief has already made arrangements with the Turks to join forces, kill the Tang envoys, and fight a big battle against the Tang!" said Guo Zhe. "If we are to cooperate and strike back, we must act before meeting the Turks!"
"Alright, I'll return to Youzhou City immediately and report to General Zhang. We'll strike in three days." Wang Hui replied promptly.

[P13] That night, Wang Hui, along with his delegation, secretly escaped from the Khitan tribe and hurried back to Youzhou City.
At dawn, the Khitan chief discovered that Wang Hui had fled and screamed in rage.

[P14] On the agreed-upon night, the campfires in the Khitan tribe had already gone out. No one could be seen except for the patrolling soldiers. Guo Zhe led a group of men, moving quietly and stealthily toward the Khitan chief's tent.
"Someone, catch the assassin!" the Khitan chief cried out in alarm. But before the soldiers could rush over, he was already seized by Guo Zhe.

[P15] "Charge!" Suddenly, cries of battle echoed outside the Khitan settlement. It turned out that Zhang Shougui had led his troops in a surprise attack. With the help of Guo Zhe from within, they successfully seized control of the Khitan settlement. Zhang Shougui reported this good news to Chang'an. Emperor Xuanzong of Tang bestowed the title of King of Beiping upon Guo Zhe, appointing him to lead the Khitans, and the border region was finally pacified.

[P16] In murky water, fish become disoriented and lose their sense of direction. At this moment, catching fish becomes easy. Zhang Shougui and Wang Hui precisely exploited the dissatisfaction of the Khitan general toward his leader, successfully inciting internal chaos within the Khitan, stirring up this calm pool, and seizing the opportunity to pacify the border crisis. This strategy is called 'muddying the waters to catch fish'.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页展示了绘本标题“浑水摸鱼”，并配有一名身穿古代铠甲、手持地图的武将插图。
[P2] 本页讲述了唐朝时期，契丹人屡次侵犯幽州，朝廷派遣名将张守珪前往镇守，他上任后成功击退了契丹军队。
[P3] 契丹使者来到幽州城门外，送来一封投降信，张守珪对此表示怀疑。
[P4] 张守珪怀疑契丹使者送来投降信的诚意，认为其目的是探查军情，但他仍接收了信件，并产生了一个反间计的策略：派人潜入契丹，制造内部混乱，以图一举歼灭。
[P5] 张守珪派王悔假扮使者前往契丹营地，递上投降信以实施反间计。契丹首领接过信后大笑，表示要先为大唐使臣接风，未察觉其真实意图。
[P6] 王悔作为大唐使者潜入契丹营地，在晚宴上观察到契丹大将过折沉默寡言，与首领态度迥异，由此推测二人之间可能存在矛盾。
[P7] 王悔潜入契丹营地后，发现契丹首领白天带他打猎、晚上饮酒作乐，从不提投降之事，且部落频繁向西北迁移，他怀疑契丹人意图逃跑。
[P8] 王悔对契丹首领的言行产生怀疑，第二天他来到大将过折的营帐，故意奉承首领以试探其反应。
[P9] 王悔故意奉承契丹首领，试探大将过折的反应。过折听后勃然大怒，斥责首领是狡诈的狼，揭露了其与首领之间的矛盾，为后续反间计的成功埋下伏笔。
[P10] 王悔在契丹大将过折面前揭露了契丹首领诈降的真相，并出示了张守珪的密信，表明自己是奉命前来与过折合作，共同对抗契丹首领。
[P11] 王悔向契丹大将过折出示密信，提出若其与大唐合作，张守珪愿保举其为王，过折听后大为心动。
[P12] 过折向王悔揭露契丹首领与突厥人密谋杀害唐朝使团并开战的计划，王悔答应立即返回幽州城向张守珪报告，约定三天后发动反击。
[P13] 王悔带着使团连夜逃离契丹部落，返回幽州城；契丹首领发现后愤怒大叫。
[P14] 约定的深夜，过折率兵突袭契丹首领的营帐，首领惊叫求援，但尚未等到士兵赶到，便已被过折擒获。
[P15] 张守珪与契丹大将过折里应外合，突袭契丹部落并成功夺取其统领权，随后过折被唐玄宗封为北平王，边关得以平定。
[P16] 本页通过比喻解释了‘浑水摸鱼’的计策：张守珪和王悔利用契丹内部矛盾，挑起内乱，趁乱平定边境危机。
